items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names are clear (buildWindowDefinition, SelectedWindow, windowSql). Each new .window() method has a JSDoc block that matches the surrounding docs. Error messages are clear, and dprint formatting was applied (lint passes).

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: The body of .window() is copied into all five dialect builders, including the inline checks `if (name.trim().length === 0) throw new Error('Window name cannot be whitespace-only')`. The conventions asked for one shared validator. buildWindowDefinition is shared correctly.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Validation is in place for empty and whitespace-only names (in both .window and .over), non-positive ntile/nthValue arguments, negative or non-integer preceding/following arguments, and frames where from comes after to. The tests confirm numeric arguments are not bound as parameters. No errors are swallowed.

items.name: Public API additions are additive and consistent across dialects
items.name_zh: 公共 API 新增保持向后兼容且各方言一致
items.evidence: The changes are purely additive. Each *SelectConfig gains an optional `windows?: SelectedWindow[]`, and the same .window() method is added to the pg, mysql, sqlite, gel and singlestore builders. windowSql is undefined when no windows are defined, so generated SQL for existing queries is unchanged. The P2P suite passes 566/566.
